notes.title: Bugfix 1.2
notes.content:
In this update, the following has been fixed:

[list]
[*] Improved overall graphics.
[*] Improved optimization.
[*] Fixed possible bugs with sound settings.
[*] Fixed possible bugs with hint button.
[*] Changed the font for the victory screen and shifted the location of the caption.
[*] Improved animation for the hint. Now the cat will be easier to spot.
[*] Changed locations of cats on the first level, from which only small body parts like tail or ear were visible. Now all cats can be identified without problems.
[/list]

Please remember that you can paint in different colors, which can be selected in the pause menu. Selecting a color will NOT change already painted cats, but will change the color on future paints.

notes.title: Bugfix 1.1
notes.content:
In this update, the following have been fixed:

[list]
[*] Non-working achievements. Now they can be obtained by completing level 1.
[*] The overall quality of graphics has been improved. Now the picture does not blur when zooming in, especially on the bonus level.
[*] Fixed problem for ultrawide 21:9 monitors. Now zooming in and zooming out works correctly.
[*] Bug related to opening additional level 2 after completing level 1. Additional level will be opened only if DLC is available. 
[/list]

Sorry this has taken so long. We had some technical difficulties that were not fixed as quickly as we would have liked.

notes.title: Choose your own name for the achievement! 🔥
notes.content:
Hi friends, with the addition of 100 achievements to the game we have a great idea. Anyone of you can suggest a cat name that will be one of the achievements in our upcoming game! 

Here is a small list of the rules according to which, we will be selecting names:
[list]

[*] 1 name per person
[*] Write the name in English, otherwise it will be localized
[*] No obviously absurd, forbidden, offensive names.
[*] You can submit at any time in the comments, up to the day of the game's release
[/list]
That's it! We'll put everyone who wants to participate in the achievement and link it to a random cat on the map, after the release you will be able to unlock this achievement in the game. Thanks for your participation, we hope you like this interactive format and we will apply it again in the future.
